subject: Title IX Sexual Discrimination Grievance Procedure
overview: The committee held a special meeting to review and approve the first reading of a comprehensive update to the district's Title IX sexual discrimination grievance protocols.

items.title: Resolution 2024-38: Policy ACGB Title IX Sexual Discrimination Grievance Procedure
items.summary: Approved the first reading of a revised 18-page policy defining protocols for reporting, investigating, and adjudicating sexual discrimination and harassment complaints to comply with updated federal regulations. The committee waived a full reading of the text and conducted a section-by-section review of the document's provisions regarding supportive measures, investigation timelines, and the appeals process.
